prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1264; do not mention it.)
text: Driver 1 was traveling westbound in the left-turn lane on a city street in Houston, Texas, intending to turn left onto a side road. Driver 2 was eastbound in the through lane and proceeded straight through the intersection as the signal changed. The two vehicles collided in the intersection, with the front driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle striking the front passenger side of Driver 2's vehicle. Both drivers remained at the scene. Driver 1 stated that she was struck while completing the turn and reported immediate pain in the lower back. Driver 2 stated that the signal had turned yellow as they entered the intersection. A Passenger in Driver 2's vehicle was present but did not report injury. Both vehicles sustained moderate front-end and side damage and were towed from the scene. Driver 1 was transported by EMS for evaluation of back strain. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation.
